title: M33 — owner publication, original customer submission and table tracking (ETA, swaps and payment choices remain open)

pages.note: Actual synthetic phone Auth, native owner selection and SQL-approved current M20 snapshot. Publication, live confirmation, private local original and owner metadata are real; the backend service stays installer configured. The Storefront frame guides the existing settings layout and control style; the new publication panel extends that layout.

The same C08 public form gains an account-free POST action, honeypot and one-tap message fallback. No price, delivery fee or payment is invented. The complete recovery bundle has its own offline cache; the original /s/ page retains its 60 KB limit.
